label: v111
changes: Fixed: AI chat conversation could carry over between your Family and Business spaces — each space now has its own separate chat
Tapping the family photo or business logo now opens it full-size instead of only opening settings
Business Document Vault now only shows business-relevant categories, not family-only ones like Education
Added employer/workplace details to a member's profile, surfaced on the Emergency card
The family/team list now collapses everyone except the person you've selected, so the list takes up less space
Creating a new business now automatically adds you as its first team member instead of showing a blank form
